intro.title: Cozy Roots
intro.welcome: We are happy to have you with us. Use this guest guide for everything you need during your stay — hotel information, dining times, activities, transport and local recommendations.
intro.about: A relaxed home base close to Fuvahmulah's lakes and reef, with a garden courtyard and warm, unhurried local hospitality — the same easy access to diving, snorkeling and island life as our sister property.

diving.title: Dive Fuvahmulah
diving.description: World-famous tiger shark and reef encounters await, arranged with our dive partner, Cozy Scuba Club.
